title: Callaloo Soup Dominican Style
description: Callaloo Soup Dominican Style is a dish from Dominica featuring yellow onion, okra, garlic, spinach. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Spinach replaces callaloo greens; the Dominican island soup has its own regional character.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 9 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 32 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Combine the prepared components from earlier steps gently into the intended final mixture; do not add new ingredients.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
